name: National Awards For Outstanding Services In The Field Of Prevention Of Alcoholism And Substance (Drug) Abuse: Best Panchayati Raj Or Municipal Body Working For Prevention Of Alcoholism And Substance (Drug) Abuse
nodalDept: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment, Government of India
targetBeneficiaries: Institutions working in prevention of alcoholism and substance abuse
briefDescription: This Central scheme recognizes outstanding services by Panchayati Raj or Municipal Bodies in the prevention of alcoholism and substance (drug) abuse.
descriptionMd: The National Awards For Outstanding Services in the Field of Prevention of Alcoholism and Substance (Drug) Abuse is a central government initiative. Specifically, this award category targets Panchayati Raj and Municipal Bodies. It aims to honor their exemplary contributions towards combating alcoholism and substance abuse in their respective jurisdictions. This recognition encourages local government bodies to enhance their efforts in public health and social welfare.
benefitsMd:
*   Recognition for outstanding services in the field of prevention of alcoholism and substance abuse.
*   Public acknowledgement of exemplary work by local governing bodies.
*   Encouragement for further efforts in public health and social welfare.
eligibilityMd:
*   Applicants must be a Panchayati Raj Body.
*   Applicants must be a Municipal Body.
*   Applicants must be actively engaged in the field of Prevention of Alcoholism and Substance (Drug) Abuse.
applicationMd: Contact the nodal department or visit the official scheme portal to apply.
